earlyStop: Stop on correctness, host, cleanup or input-audit failure. If the first valid candidate/control pair has candidate proof time more than 5% slower, preserve that result and leave the remaining six runs NOT RUN; this conservative experiment stop is not a production threshold or population regression claim.
attribution: The legacy application phase clocks retain their wall-time meaning. The host wrapper records monotonic duration and wall-minus-monotonic drift. Use paired proof time, unchanged routing as a control, and the repeated seed-7 range; do not attribute every whole-request difference to LU or claim additive gains.
limits: Small focused corpus spanning 20/37/40 parts; the predeclared normal and scale corpora remain intact and unrun. Normal publication stays disabled. Full final acceptance waits for all hard gates, including normal cold margin and scale coverage. No push.
